parsed.explanation: Combined regime documented as predatory enforcement, not a dead-letter sexuality law: 2014 act bans same-sex cohabitation, public affection and organisations with 10-14 years, with documented police torture, arbitrary arrests, mass hotel/party raids in 2018 and 2023, and extortion of a man who 'looked gay' in 2025. Northern Sharia adds death penalty for male same-sex acts. Trans-specific evidence includes a 2024 trans-woman killing with no charges after six months and police misgendering, discretionary custody exemplified by a trans woman in maximum security, dating-app luring/blackmail, and fear of cross-dressing proposals. No legal protections; victims fear police and medical care. If outed, arrest, extortion, violence or prolonged detention is documented, with impunity.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented police torture, arbitrary arrests, mass raids 2018-2023, discretionary custody; 2024 trans woman served six months in maximum-security prison, section not recorded, placement found to breach correctional act.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Investigative panel found maximum-security placement breached statute for first-time offender, but did not prevent it.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Discretionary placement after arrest compounds police-targeting risk; detention can out visitor and expose to abuse.

care_services.exposure: Documented fear of seeking medical care due to arrest/extortion risk; activists report act hampered HIV prevention and community health work.
care_services.interaction: Constitutional nominal health guarantee does not displace criminalisation or fear of disclosure in care.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Secular law up to 14 years nationally; northern Sharia death penalty for male same-sex acts; cross-dressing criminalisation proposed, enactment not established; law described as weaponised and sanctioning abuse.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No legal protections for LGBTQ+ people documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Same-sex law is documented as a lever against gender-nonconforming people through raids, torture and extortion, not merely a tangential statute.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: 2024 beaten body of trans woman found, no suspect charged six months later; dating-app gangs lure, beat, film and blackmail with outing threats; police themselves extort and beat.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Police ordered investigation described as thorough/discreet; no arrests resulted.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police as perpetrators and non-response to killing mean reporting risks further exposure.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No legal protections; frequency of prosecutions not quantified; custody sex placement typical result not recorded.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Absence of quantified enforcement does not offset documented raids, torture and impunity.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: recurring police sweeps/raids, imprisonment, custody abuse risk and courts/police as threat. This case adds documented torture and northern death-penalty exposure, but trans presentation itself is not shown as a capital offence with near-certain execution, so not clearly below 0.15.

Worse than 0.25-A: that anchor has raids/extortion and custody harassment without routine death-penalty exposure or documented torture; here torture, 10-14-year penalties, mass arrests, impunity for trans killing and northern death penalty increase severity.

Higher than 0.05: execution is not documented as near-certain after identification for trans presentation nationally; death penalty is tied to northern Sharia same-sex provisions, and no systematic execution of trans visitors is documented.

parsed.synthesis: Exposure is state-led and street-level simultaneously: police raids, torture and extortion under a long-sentence law; northern death-penalty exposure; dating-app blackmail leveraging outing; and impunity for a trans killing. Discretionary maximum-security custody and fear of care/police complete the interaction. No operative traveller-facing protection is documented. Adult travelling with a minor faces the same detention/outing risks for the guardian, with no documented mitigations; specific minor rules are not documented.
